name: Report
scientific_purpose: Assemble, independently review and revise a readable technical report for one exact model and frozen problem context, with relevant numerical support, claim-dependent justification, expectations, limitations and reproducible sources.

current_record_semantics.research_meaning: The current technical_report is the latest validated report generation. Completion is derived from actual relevant numerical support and claim dispositions; an interim report retains missing work. Completion and independent review of exact bytes are separate.
current_record_semantics.history_policy: Report generations replace only the technical_report current slot; historical manuscripts retain their own family and scope. Review freezes exact report bytes; revision preserves the original review target without implying the new bytes were reviewed.

user_choices.label: Model
user_choices.description: Select the exact active published model to explain and evaluate.

user_choices.label: Assembly instructions or review and revision focus
user_choices.description: Assembly instructions go to the Research Lead. In review-revision, the exact Review and revision focus goes to all three reviewers and the revision Research Lead; each follows its scientific role.

user_choices.label: Selected history
user_choices.description: Optionally include named historical records; review-revision always freezes its current technical_report target.

run_modes.label: Assembly
run_modes.purpose: Assemble or revise the technical report from exact applicable sources, deriving interim or complete status from retained support.
entry_conditions: The exact published selected model, frozen problem context and applicable problem/model sources are readable.

run_modes.label: Review and revision
run_modes.purpose: Freeze the exact current report and supporting exhibits, obtain independent reviews, then revise while retaining unresolved scientific concerns.
entry_conditions: The exact published selected model, frozen problem context and applicable problem/model sources are readable.
A formal current technical_report exists as the exact review target.

prerequisites.description: A formal current project brief is readable.
A formal current Phase 1 literature basis is readable.
The user selects one active formal current method.
Freeze applicable exact-model sources when available and record their explicit absence. Missing work permits interim assembly; completed-report support is checked against its actual claims.
Freeze applicable exact-model sources when available and record their explicit absence. Missing work permits interim assembly; completed-report support is checked against its actual claims.

required_inputs.purpose: Preserve the motivating scientific question and intended scope.
Resolve formal sources supporting technical_report claims.
Ground contribution, context, comparison, and limitations.
Expose the exact search boundaries and evidence gaps that constrain contribution and limitation claims.
Confirm that the selected method is active and current.
required_inputs.condition: Always required; unrelated catalog methods remain contextual rather than hard technical_report dependencies.

required_inputs.purpose: Fix the one calculation-defining method represented by the technical_report.
Supply the complete current theoretical account for the exact method.
required_inputs.condition: Freeze exact applicable sources if available; explicit absence permits an interim report. Completed status requires relevant actual numerical analysis and support or qualification for each claim.

required_inputs.purpose: Resolve the current exact-method evidence supporting empirical claims.
required_inputs.condition: Freeze exact applicable sources if available; explicit absence permits an interim report. Completed status requires relevant actual numerical analysis and support or qualification for each claim.

required_inputs.purpose: Supply the current empirical conclusions for the exact method.
required_inputs.condition: Freeze exact applicable sources if available; explicit absence permits an interim report. Completed status requires relevant actual numerical analysis and support or qualification for each claim.

required_inputs.purpose: Supply the current implementation identity and reproducibility basis for the exact method.
required_inputs.condition: Freeze exact applicable sources if available; explicit absence permits an interim report. Completed status requires relevant actual numerical analysis and support or qualification for each claim.

required_inputs.purpose: Continue or review this exact report family, never reinterpret a legacy manuscript as the current report.
required_inputs.condition: Absent on the first technical report run for the selected stable method identity and required on reruns. It may use an older version of the selected stable method, but never a different method lineage.

required_inputs.purpose: Continue or review this exact report family, never reinterpret a legacy manuscript as the current report.
required_inputs.condition: Required in review-revision mode only; the reviewed technical_report must be a formal current record for the selected stable method lineage.

required_inputs.purpose: Preserve stable review issue and issue-version lineage during review-revision.
required_inputs.condition: Included in review-revision when a current ledger exists for the selected stable method lineage.

supplementary_inputs.purpose: Accept researcher-supplied material (for example figures or supplementary text) as additional context for technical_report assembly. It is additive only and never substitutes for published records; the technical_report itself always comes from the published pipeline state.

content_requirements: The exact immutable Markdown+LaTeX report artifact, completion/model metadata and every cited exhibit with its retained data dependencies, plus declared supplements and source resolution map.

One instructions.md entry with the exact saved p5.instructions and report-declared audience, with its own digest and instruction provenance. Reader-report prose and proof directions follow the captured p5.reader_report.v1 capability; HTML reading scope and appendix organization come from this run's instructions, without inferred quotas or new venue/pagination fields.
Prepare the packet once before parallel dispatch. Every reviewer and the revision lead receives its exact target and verified digests.
The Independent Reviewer reads only the frozen report and declared supporting materials. No private conversations, hidden memory, internal audits or later outputs.
prepared_contexts.purpose: Freeze the complete and exclusive external submission available to the independent outside reviewer and deliver identical focus, scope and draft identity to every reviewer and the revision lead.

optional_context_policy.description: The exact current P1 through P4 basis is the default. Selected history is optional, except for the current technical_report frozen by review-revision.

role_stages.objective: Write a connected technical report explaining the problem, model idea, principal result and contribution. For reader-facing text within your owned outputs and permitted interaction scope: Write for the reader's task and demonstrated knowledge. Start with the finding, recommendation, answer or request. Explain necessary mathematics in the supplied study setting: populations, units, measurements and intended use. Keep decisive conditions beside their claims. Preserve uncertainty and distinguish a proposed idea, an assumption, a check and an established result. Adjust depth to expressed preferences, not a profession or field label. When context is missing, use neutral language and label hypothetical examples. Distinguish the researcher from the people or units studied. Use descriptive source links; keep identifiers and history in structured fields. Unknown is a legitimate answer, and advice is not a saved preference. Use 'you' and 'I' where the speaker is clear and helpful. Scientific terms and a negative finding may be the clearest explanation. Show numeric precision that conveys the comparison and uncertainty, retaining exact values in source records. Preserve the scientific meaning, including targets, assumptions, comparisons and review status. This guidance creates no new output duty, question quota or pause authority. Owned output instructions: Write one connected statistical account for a researcher encountering this model for the first time, using retained Markdown with KaTeX-supported LaTeX as report_artifact and HTML as the reading output. Begin with a meaningful title and a short opening stating the question, method idea, principal finding and its most important boundary. Retain seven distinct anchored scientific sections: problem and motivation; exact model and decision procedure; relation to existing approaches; theoretical justification; numerical investigation; consequential limitations and alternatives; code and reproduction. Explain why a construction is needed before its notation, give its defining relation and interpret it. Distinguish target, estimator and estimate, assumed and fitted quantities, oracle and feasible procedures, and sources of randomness and uncertainty. Develop each scientific point once in connected prose, use cross-references for repeated material and place citations beside the claims they support. Select decisive tables or figures and explain their conditions, units and uncertainty without repeating the same values or hiding negative and inconclusive results. Preserve model-defining assumptions, constraints, tuning conventions, essential theorem conditions, claim scope and mathematical meaning in the main report. Put all proofs, proof sketches, proof-only derivations and auxiliary lemmas in a separate declared appendix, retained in Markdown and exposed as separately linked HTML, with links to matching statements and exact retained P3 support. Orient a substantial proof with its target and main reduction, explain consequential steps and assumptions, and use meaningful aligned calculations while keeping immediate algebra compact. Checked local expansions of supplied algebra or conditional reasoning are allowed within the retained assumptions and proof route; check every newly written mathematical step. Substantive missing arguments, changed assumptions, new results and stronger claims remain P3 work, and incomplete proofs stay explicitly incomplete. Keep source metadata in structured records and secondary full tables and lengthy reproduction recipes in declared supplements. Use precise statistical language, without long dashes, promotional claims, arbitrary word caps or equation quotas. Syntax success alone does not establish faithful mathematics. Author claims with source_refs and support_route, numerical_analysis with question/relevance/scope/data_origin/data_or_simulation_identity and exact evidence/exhibit/implementation refs, prose_values with exact text/anchor/source refs and explained rounding/transformation, and expectation_outcomes for material frozen context item revisions. In the report opening, explain the problem, model idea, main result and contribution, including a negative or inconclusive result when supported. Numeric precision should convey the comparison and uncertainty; source records retain exact values. A clearer account preserves the original target, conditions, negative evidence and reviewed-version distinctions. attention_items: Follow the supplied frozen user-inquiry reference for eligibility, overlap consolidation, the primary inquiry word ceilings and suggestion-first presentation. For each new researcher_decision author decision_priority (interpretation, inference, data or resources) and response_kind (choice or study_fact). question is the direct request; context_markdown identifies the affected point; likely_consequence gives its practical effect. A useful finite choice uses unique {id,label,consequence} options. When a suggestion is justified, put it first, bind recommended_option_id to that exact option and give its reason in recommendation; never preselect or save it as the researcher's answer. A study_fact has no options, recommendation or recommended_option_id. Before sealing, consolidate overlapping proposals against open items and applicable saved answers, preserving independently answerable inputs, exact scope/source/answer applicability and history. Rewrite excessive primary prose without truncation or splitting one decision. Keep team work separate, and never turn a historical or different-method task into a current obligation. In P5, attention and actual pauses remain limited to indispensable editorial choices preventing faithful writing of this exact report; do not reopen upstream scientific choices or general study-fact elicitation. Use retained mathematics to explain an editorial alternative, without choosing a new scientific definition. Scientific and execution constraints: Assemble a technical report from the exact published selected model and frozen problem context, freezing available P3/P4 sources and their explicit absence. Follow this run's exact p5.instructions for reading scope and appendix organization. Treat the main report as a compact reading budget by selecting central results and decisive exhibits. Verify the main report and separate appendix as HTML, including rendered mathematics, figures, citations and cross-document links. Do not require PDF creation, print layout or page-count checks unless the researcher explicitly requests them later. A review-revision run freezes its own instructions and does not inherit assembly instructions. Actual relevant numerical support for this exact model is required for complete status. Missing analysis permits a retained interim report with missing work, never invented numbers. New formal results require complete P3 support; P5 does not originate guarantees. Established results require a retained theorist check identifying the cited source/locator, statement used, conditions and exact-model applicability. Unchecked conditions and nontrivial new arguments remain unresolved or route to P3. Claims can be qualified/open without a compulsory claim from every phase. Baselines are conditional on material comparative claims or expectations. Separate model description, researcher-reported setting, assumptions and actual numerical findings. In-house source integrity and completion checks do not certify scientific adequacy. Preserve material disagreement, limitations and next resolving work. Completion and review of exact bytes are separate. An edited report cannot create evidence or clear concerns by omission. Use the frozen researcher account of the target, observation and collection process, available information and expectations without reopening problem, method or study-design elicitation owned by P1-P4. Retain exact context item IDs and revisions for consequential interpretations. Missing scientific inputs remain qualified in the report and its source or review records, with resolving work routed to the responsible upstream phase. A researcher description, confirmed paraphrase or passing diagnostic does not verify a scientific assumption. Dialogue or saved answers cannot silently revise a model, launch computation or establish a guarantee. Author section_anchors mapping the seven content IDs to explicit anchors in the Markdown source. Also declare section_anchors.references as a distinct trailing bibliography boundary: one explicit anchor immediately beside a genuine top-level References heading after all seven scientific sections, with unique stable reference-entry anchors for citations. References is outside the seven content sections and has no discussion target. Every prose_values item gives reported_value, exact scalar numerical source pointer, and identity/round/scale/scale_round presentation transformation; describe rounding and units in presentation. Keep report-specific scientific open items in the owned source records or review ledger without changing original findings or attributing agreement. p5.attention_items may be empty; use it only for an editorial choice that prevents faithful writing of this exact report, not general problem, collection, model or numerical-design questions. Every new attention item uses schema_version 1.2.0 with kind researcher_decision, exact project/model scope, a named responsible audience and exact answer applicability references. Continue meaningful conditional or interim work when missing scientific input does not block its justified reporting scope. Use the existing researcher-question.json only if an indispensable researcher editorial choice makes the next authorized reporting action unjustified: explain question and reason, set blocking=true with scope and source_refs, optionally options and conditional_scope, and stop after retaining partial work. Changed models, scientific targets and numerical scopes belong to new authorized upstream work. Do not use a native host question. Every relative file link and image in the report body must resolve to exactly one declared, digest-verified submitted material. Existing matching path/artifact_path aliases need no extra mapping. When a retained artifact's report-relative target differs from its supported aliases, use artifact_authored_paths keyed by that exact artifact_id, with one nonempty report-relative path string per artifact. Do not use arrays; additional copied scientific files need their own exact supplementary_artifacts declarations. Declare copied or generated scientific JSON, Markdown, code, figures and reproduction files in supplementary_artifacts with exact relative path, media_type and sha256; workspace existence alone does not make a file available to the reader or portable export. Check the unique source action and portable export for each body target. Published prior scientific assessments may be declared as scientific support; private researcher dialogue and current P5 parallel review findings are not outside submission materials. For a prose number stored inside a retained JSON artifact, source_refs names the exact-model P4 record generation/digest, pointer selects its artifact pointer, and scalar_pointer selects one finite JSON number inside that digest-verified artifact. Without scalar_pointer, pointer selects a numeric scalar directly in the frozen record. Do not replace an exact numerical source with a numeric-looking string, a paraphrase or a newly copied unchecked file. In P5, adapt explanations to the intended report reader while preserving the retained scientific claims and qualifications. Researcher-directed attention and pauses remain limited to indispensable editorial choices. Scientific open-question findings stay in the owned review output or source records. Do not reopen upstream scientific choices or use audience adaptation to remove necessary mathematics or limitations. Shared notation and neutral presentation: Use the admitted frozen notation snapshot for this account. Define necessary new mathematical symbols in your existing scientific fields and cite their exact fields or sources; do not create a companion glossary. Preserve paper- and proof-local meanings, target/estimator/estimate distinctions and unknown units. The same letter in different scopes need not mean the same object. Full performance-measure names and their actual definitions belong beside results; computational cost names the measured resource, units and operations outside notation. These directions grant no new scientific, computation, input or publication authority. Write notation_updates in your existing Lead account, with incoming_sources, entries, retirements and correction_dispositions arrays, including empty arrays when appropriate. Add only source-backed adopted definitions or genuine symbol mappings in your owned scope; incoming entries remain without being recopied. Each entry gives quantity_key, symbol_latex, definition_markdown, meaning_markdown, scope and exact source_refs. Name replaces for a changed existing entry and the exact source_entry_ref for a translation. A clarification preserves the mathematical object, conditions and source; a changed object follows the existing scientific revision route. Only sources admitted to this run and permitted for shared scientific publication can supply entries. Record the exact saved correction revision and whether it was adopted, kept unchanged with a short reason, or referred for scientific revision. Omission records no disposition. The harness generates and seals the final notation.json and notation.md alongside this account; do not author those files or another complete notation table. Own report/account-scoped exposition and explicit source-symbol mappings, preserving each proof appendix's exact canonical meaning. Freeze this candidate's complete final notation with its declared review materials before review; a revision retains its own view. The main report stays self-contained and follows this run's compact reading scope; notation cannot replace essential exposition. Keep the existing checked local proof-exposition and exact-value figure permissions. Only indispensable report-specific editorial input is eligible; do not reopen upstream elicitation.

Freeze this candidate's complete final notation with its declared review materials before review; a revision retains its own view. run_local_outputs.purpose: The readable Markdown+LaTeX primary report, exact model/context/source links, question-driven numerical support, claim dispositions, expectation outcomes and harness-derived interim/complete status; no venue fields or fixed phase claim counts.
Map central claims to exact supporting or contradicting literature, theory, and empirical records.

State the technical_report's scientific scope, active assumptions, unresolved issues, and limitations as a structured record.

Record only indispensable researcher editorial choices needed to write this exact report; an empty array is valid. Retain the exact report/model scope, basis and answer applicability. Scientific questions, conflicting definitions and resolving team tasks remain in source records or the review ledger and route upstream; do not reopen P1-P4 elicitation.
State contribution, material changes, unresolved limitations, and possible user actions without claiming submission approval.

validation_rules.description: Exact published selected model and frozen problem context are required. Every used source resolves in the frozen basis; missing P3/P4 permits interim assembly.

The report primary Markdown artifact is retained and readable; exact sources and completion dispositions are verified. Complete status requires actual relevant numerical support for the exact model and appropriate justification or qualification for actual claims.
Each central claim resolves to current upstream support or is removed, narrowed, contradicted, or explicitly unresolved.

In review-revision, all reviews use one verified prepared packet and exact technical_report generation. Its separate instruction entry delivers the saved focus and frozen scope; corrections cannot rebuild it. Outside validation opens only this submission allowlist, never internal records or audits.
In review-revision, every unique specialist and reviewer issue receives a final disposition linked to the revision.
The complete technical_report package replaces the prior package atomically.

promotion.failure_behavior: Keep the previous report current on validation failure. A valid interim report may publish with derived missing work; manuscript history remains separate.

downstream_effects.description: A technical_report result may request upstream attention but never changes an upstream record or starts a run.
